_comment: Deal 3 arcane to any target; Starfall - if an instant card has been put into your graveyard this turn, INSTEAD deal 4. Modeled with a CONDITIONAL_EFFECT on the STARFALL_FLAG (then deal 4, else deal 3). Prior JSON (a) gated the whole ability on the flag (dealing nothing without it), (b) used an unrecognized 'alternative_effects' key, and (c) used ability_type INSTANT (fires on ON_ACTIVATE) for a PLAYED action card, so it never fired on play; corrected to PLAY.
